project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra ecosystem pairing poster

main_subject.detail: Lifestyle-free ecosystem poster showing the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra in landscape drawing mode alongside a white S Pen, Galaxy Buds case, Galaxy Z Flip-style foldable phone, and Galaxy Watch to present the ultimate dream-team setup.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic clean product arrangement, ecosystem hero render, premium Samsung device family poster

composition_elements.text: The ultimate dream team / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra
items: Top Left: Large centered black title 'The ultimate dream team'.
Top Right: Smaller centered subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Bottom Left: Small gray footnotes about products being sold separately and image simulation.
Bottom Right: Negative space around the accessory arrangement.

Center/Background: Landscape Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra showing a tennis-court style illustration, with a white S Pen to the left, open Galaxy Buds case above, blue foldable phone to the upper right, and a black Galaxy Watch on the far right.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean hardware shadows, light reflections on accessories, airy premium ecosystem presentation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra ecosystem pairing poster. Centerpiece is a landscape Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra on an off-white background, displaying a tennis-court style creative canvas, surrounded by a white S Pen, an open Galaxy Buds case, a blue foldable Galaxy phone, and a black Galaxy Watch. Background is bright and minimal with lots of empty space. Surrounding elements: exact title 'The ultimate dream team', subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', and small gray footnotes about products being sold separately. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, clean hardware shadows and airy premium presentation, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
